G08.blocked: C-08 full Terminal.app restart: native BLOCKED/not executed; formally deferred to isolated M15 qualification by D-0006. H-10 independently closed by the final remediation run.
G08.scope: H-10 closed on 89fce79: actual fullscreen/Space entry, away, exact Return, exit and exact Return again; two causal target-close overlaps, TARGET_GONE / READBACK_FAILED, target-only focus, zero wrong targets. C-11 Space false negative repaired, but the existing aggregate deadline is unenforced: phases after the pre-focus check can return exact/OK after two seconds. Final ordinary/fullscreen routes took 805/1109/821 ms; qualification holds are not ordinary timing evidence.

G09.scope: C-02 admission repair accepted: positive LOGIN_ITEM classification and preference/supervision/maintenance/awake predicate. A-F pass their executed cases, old 8c82212 controls fail behaviorally, and six independence/crash scenarios pass on 89fce79. Yield drains intents before a 500 ms exit while callbacks remain accepted; unsupervised Enable can also exit before a claimant. Preserve accepted pending intents across both paths, including late callbacks and handoff reply failure. Exclusive writer ownership and durable journal records are not shown violated.

G10.scope: 57,799 acknowledged receipts rechecked with zero missing across five live process-crash rounds; total may include post-relaunch admissions. Separate deterministic commit/ACK crash suite supplies boundary proof. No power-loss claim. Rerun on 89fce79: 58,895 acknowledged, 0 lost over five rounds; second writer refused (75); idempotent retry ALREADY_COMMITTED at its cursor.

G12.scope: Five harness sleepnow commands matched five Software Sleep/RTC cycles: 71 seconds by OS timestamps each, OS wakes one second after schedule. Companion wakes 1.239–1.286 seconds after schedule. OS reason contains rtc/HID Activity; no idle or multi-touch/manual wake sequence in the accepted run.

G15.scope: 906.054 s packaged workload remains credited (111/123 live canvas pairs above threshold, all 123 differ, minutes 7-15 match the journal). H-11 independently closed: real renderer initialization awaits a held genuine adapter result; renderer retires before release/completion, discards late init, schedules no hidden frames, then recovers fresh WebGPU/pixels. The native adapter itself had settled while held. A genuine same-scheme response remains pending across old-view retirement and releases only after a new view hydrates/applies its own resource, with no late consumption. C-12 is diagnostic-only, assigned to M1.

G16.manualExternalRequired: C-09 physical external-monitor unplug/reconnect: MANUAL_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED/not executed; formally deferred to M15 hardware qualification by D-0006. H-12 independently closed by actual VoiceOver operation.
G16.scope: Under D-0006. H-12 independently closed: VoiceOver cursor reports and perform action produce 3D to 2D, then after actual fullscreen enter/exit 2D to 3D, verified by independent lifecycle state; keyboard regression passes. VoiceOver, scripting, welcome and output mute restored; authorized Terminal-to-VoiceOver Automation consent remains, inert with scripting disabled. H-14 history retained. Earlier built-in-display/window/DPR/AX/Reduce Motion proofs remain credited.

G17.scope: Independent re-review requires only C-02 handoff intent preservation and C-11 whole-route deadline enforcement plus their focused regressions. H-10/H-11/H-12 accepted; C-12 nonblocking M1 diagnostics; D-0004-D-0006 and C-04 mandatory M1 closure unchanged. No merge or M1 authorization.

caseLimitations.C-02: A-F do not cover callbacks after Yield drains the queue or pending intent when Enable exits before the claimant. 337 scans show no observed overlap; derived 0 ms is not a continuous measurement. Lifetime exclusive flock and native second-writer refusal substantiate exclusion. E explicitly kills probes after ten seconds, not a native idle-exit test.
caseLimitations.H-10: Close-case supplementary selection inventories are empty; rely on target-only fixed script, retained native focus evidence and conservative results, not the vacuous unchanged-selection assertion. Space route is 1109 ms; 96 ms is its subsequent visibility witness.
caseLimitations.H-11: The genuine adapter result is withheld after the native request settles; real renderer initialization remains pending. No claim of GPU driver work remaining busy during the entire hold.
caseLimitations.qualificationIsolation: Native route fault variants/handlers and resource holds compile out. Release rejects qualification clients; the known resource-hold UI envelope parses but returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Frontend helpers remain bundled but inactive behind the immutable native flag; no supported release fault-execution path. M15 production-artifact cleanup remains required.

remainingCodeDefects.finding: Accepted inspector intents can be lost after Yield drains the queue or when unsupervised Enable exits before a claimant; a dropped yield reply is also unacknowledged.
remainingCodeDefects.minimumRemediation: Preserve accepted pending intents across both handoff exits until responsibility transfers; deterministic post-drain/delayed-hydration, delayed/unavailable claimant and handoff-reply-failure coverage, then targeted native notification/handoff regression.

remainingCodeDefects.finding: Only pre-focus time is checked; fresh phase budgets permit late exact/OK after the hard two-second native route deadline.
remainingCodeDefects.minimumRemediation: One remaining deadline across native validation/focus/readback/postvalidation, conservative expiration with honest already-issued OS-effect evidence, deterministic delayed-phase coverage and ordinary/fullscreen native regression.
